description: Manage Puppet module dependency ranges in metadata.json via the Forge API

customManagers.description: Update version_requirement ranges for Forge modules in metadata.json (assumes name precedes version_requirement, as in all puppetsync-managed modules)

packageRules.description: Widen metadata.json ranges (keep the floor, raise the ceiling) instead of replacing them. NOTE: requires Renovate to honor rangeStrategy for custom managers — see the PR that added this preset before extending it.
